verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official MCP server (docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server) that lets MCP clients/agents search channels, send messages, manage canvases, lists, and upload files—clearly documented first-party capability for connecting an agent via MCP. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server working in practice, and any community discussion confirming real-world adoption.
